sources.quote: For models with a 1.05M context window (GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 pro), prompts with >272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and 1.5x output for the full session for standard, batch, and flex.
sources.supports: OpenAI had documented the 272K long-context pricing threshold on the April 8 snapshot, before the models.dev correction.

notes: The earlier 200,000-token tier was a models.dev error: OpenAI's archived model page already specified the 272K threshold on March 5 and still did so on April 8, when models.dev began recording the earlier value. These sources establish the threshold, not an effective date for any provider price change; no price change is supported, so effective_at is null.
